    A₀ has a normed multiplicative basis #

    Proposition 4.14 (scalar-normalization.tex): "The endpoint chains and Corollary 3.3 show that the intersection of the resulting basis with each radical power is a basis of that power."

    The path-length grading of the scalar mesh category grades A₀ = (Alg F₀)ᵒᵖ (lenA0); the basis of Proposition 4.14 consists of homogeneous elements of corners, so by the layer argument (GradedLayers.lean) it is adapted to every radical power, and A₀ has a normed multiplicative basis (hasNormedBasis_A0).
